chapters.title: Power BI does not run your steps in order
How to fix the broken order
The real order of Power BI

takeaways: Applied Steps in Power Query describe a logical order, while the engine builds a dependency tree and executes an optimized physical plan that can defer, reorder or skip steps.
Query folding pushes transformations back to the source; one non-foldable step such as a custom function or index column makes every downstream step run locally and can turn seconds into minutes.

Keep queries foldable by checking View Native Query and query diagnostics, separate source, staging and load queries, avoid uncontrolled query references, and move heavy logic into SQL views or Fabric.
hook: Power BI refreshes that crawl are rarely a DAX problem; they come from misunderstanding how Power Query orders and executes your steps. This episode is for Power BI developers and analysts who want to understand logical versus physical execution, keep query folding intact, and structure queries so refresh times become predictable.
